description: Read-only native-XGR value-flow analysis starting from one transaction. Use model="possible" for conservative attribution ranges or model="proportional" for haircut attribution. Native XGR has no per-coin identity, so results are provenance models rather than proof that a specific coin moved. maxTransfers and maxHops accept a number or "all"; "all" is still bounded by Explorer server safety caps and reports truncation explicitly.

amountWei.description: Optional amount of the seed transaction value to trace in wei. Defaults to the full native XGR value of the seed transaction.

maxHops.description: Maximum propagation hops from the seed recipient, or "all" subject to server safety caps.

maxTransfers.description: Maximum propagated transfers to return, or "all" to continue until exhaustion subject to server safety caps.

minAttributedWei.description: Ignore branches whose possible/attributed amount falls below this wei threshold.

model.description: possible returns attribution ranges; proportional applies a haircut/share model.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash to inspect or resolve.

name: trace_xgr_value_flow

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Trace native XGR value provenance
